name: Mg2+
reason: Bath magnesium is the manipulation of the state hypothesis and a measured condition of the isolated NMDA-receptor arms (package nmda_composition_discrim, M-N6): a physiological variable, not a reagent

name: Ca2+

name: Zn2+
reason: Tonic extracellular zinc changes the maximal inhibition of triheteromers (D03) and is unmeasured in the slice: a physiological variable that decides how a modulator is read
